raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

When the target model's attention backend is not a supported DFLASH draft backend, `_resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend` falls back to FlashInfer on every CUDA GPU. That happens for DSA models such as GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek V4 (`attention_backend=dsa`). On B200 the FlashInfer fallback is much slower than FA4 for the DFLASH draft.

## Modifications

- `speculative_hook.py`: the fallback is `fa4` on SM100/SM110 (`get_platform().is_sm100_or_sm110`). Other CUDA GPUs keep `flashinfer`, and ROCm and XPU keep `triton`. An explicit `--speculative-draft-attention-backend` still wins.
- `test_dflash_draft_backend_fallback.py`: with an unsupported target backend (`dsa`), the resolver picks `fa4` on SM100, `flashinfer` on other CUDA GPUs, and `triton` on ROCm and XPU.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change: the draft model and verification are the same; only the draft attention kernel changes. With FA4 the DFLASH worker keeps the draft KV cache in BF16 (it already logs `DFLASH fa4 draft: overriding KV cache dtype ...`). Accepted tokens per verify step were the same within run noise (2.5 to 2.9 with either backend, 8 to 32 requests per point).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GLM-5.3-Flash (FP8 fine-tune), TP8 on one B200 node, v0.5.20, an 8-layer DFLASH drafter (block size 8, sliding window 2,048), 16 prompts of 60K cached tokens, 1,536 output tokens at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95. Time per verify step:

| Draft attention backend | 1 request | 4 requests | 16 requests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flashinfer` (current fallback for `dsa`) | 9.05 ms | 11.32 ms | 16.03 ms |
| `fa4` (`--speculative-draft-attention-backend fa4`) | 7.14 ms | 9.45 ms | 14.20 ms |

## Validation

- On a B200 node, with the `python/` tree of this branch's base (`main`) and the repository test file: the new test fails on `main` (`AssertionError: 'flashinfer' != 'fa4'`) and passes with this change. `test_oot_dflash_hooks.py` and the new test pass together (7 passed, 6 subtests).
- `ruff format` and `isort` pass for the changed files.
- The speed numbers above come from v0.5.20 with the backend set by flag; this branch was not run end to end on `main`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed: the default changes only when no supported backend was given.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import (
+    _resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.platforms.interface import SRTPlatform
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HOOK_MODULE = "sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook"
+
+
+class TestDFlashDraftBackendFallback(CustomTestCase):
+    def _resolve(self, *, sm100: bool = False, hip: bool = False, xpu: bool = False):
+        args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            device="custom",
+            speculative_algorithm="DFLASH",
+            speculative_draft_model_path="draft",
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=4,
+        )
+        platform = Mock(spec=SRTPlatform)
+        platform.is_out_of_tree.return_value = False
+        device = SimpleNamespace(is_xpu=xpu, is_hip=hip, is_sm100_or_sm110=sm100)
+        with (
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.current_platform", platform),
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.get_platform", return_value=device),
+            # A target backend the DFLASH draft worker does not support.
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.attention_backends_of", return_value=("dsa", None)),
+            self.assertLogs(HOOK_MODULE, "WARNING"),
+        ):
+            _resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend(args)
+        return resolution_result(args, "speculative_draft_attention_backend")
+
+    def test_unsupported_target_backend_falls_back_to_fa4_on_sm100(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(sm100=True), "fa4")
+
+    def test_other_cuda_gpus_keep_flashinfer(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(), "flashinfer")
+
+    def test_rocm_and_xpu_keep_triton(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(hip=True), "triton")
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(xpu=True), "triton")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
